lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Hello Commander.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: My name is Marciana. I'm a teacher at the M.M.R. Vocational School.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Looking forward to working with you.
Likewise.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I've seen a lot of students use Bla,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: but this is my first time using it to chat with someone.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I'm not entirely sure what to say.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: What kind of conversations do you usually have on here?
We can talk about anything you like.
We can talk about your day.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: What do I like...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Like what I do on a daily basis?
There is no reply from Marciana for a while.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Bla is tougher to use than I thought.
Just relax and say whatever comes to mind.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: If that's the case...
There is no reply from Marciana for a while.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Would it be okay for me to talk about my student?
Of course.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Rei gave me some chocolate after class today.
That's sweet.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Isn't it?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: She was very keen on pointing out that she'd gotten me heart-shaped ones.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: But, because she gave me so many, I couldn't eat them all.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I don't want to throw them away, but I don't know what to do with the rest of them.
We could eat some of them together.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Right now?
Why not? Are you busy?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Because of exam markings, my schedule is a bit tight at the moment.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I don't think it is possible right now.
Then let's meet when you're not busy.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I should be done in a few hours.
